verdict.rationale: Veriff's docs list a "No-code identity verification solution", which points toward sending verifications without engineering work, but the pack gives only that one-line heading with no detail on how it works. The other evidence describes session creation via API/SDK (developer work) and a Customer Portal used for reviewing sessions, not for sending them. Missing for 10: documented portal or no-code generation of shareable verification links, QR code support, a step-by-step ops workflow for sending one-off verifications, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
